name: Alte Post
beschreibung: Hotel Alte Post in Fieberbrunn is a time-honored hotel located in the center of the village. Situated close to the valley cable car station, it serves as an ideal base for both hiking excursions and skiing adventures. Guest rooms are styled in classic Tyrolean decor while offering modern amenities. An on-site restaurant specializes in authentic regional cuisine. The building's historic charm is especially evident in its traditional wooden dining parlors. Guests can also unwind in a wellness area featuring a sauna and steam bath. A warm, peaceful atmosphere and personalized service await every visitor.
